To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
energy is the key factor in the development of our society.
energy justice is an emerging concept, which can be understood as an ethical principle that aims at ensuring a fair distribution of energy resources among people, groups, and nations.
“Renewable energy is a new technological age that gives strength to the ideas of good governance and stewardship of social goods”.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following topics: The development of the energy system and the energy transition The role of energy in social and economic processes Energy justice and the social implications of the energy transition Energy, culture and cultural diversity The role of technology and innovation in the energy transition Social innovation and the energy transition
energy and the energy sector in a social and cultural context.
the development and implementation of a model for the sustainable and just development of energy supply systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the energy transition is not only an economic and technological process.
energy is the central interface between the economic and the ecological, the social and the technological, the political and the cultural.
the energy transition is not a technical challenge but a political one (cp. Hübotter et al., 2007
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have to change our way of thinking and acting in order to create a new energy culture, which is sustainable, just, and which is able to create prosperity and happiness for all people.
we are in an age of energy transformation.
energy is the interface between nature and culture.
The main takeaway from our work is that
energy is the interface between the economy and nature, and that energy is the basis of the economy.
the transition to renewable energies is an opportunity to reorganise our economic and political system, and to reorientate it in the direction of a sustainable society.
we need to move away from a fossil fuel economy to a sustainable energy economy.
